Installation of the compiled version

The compiled version of SPARTAN does not require MATLAB and is the easiest to set up.

Uninstall previous versions

Uninstall any previous versions of SPARTAN. On Windows, use Start → Control Panel → Uninstall a program. On Linux and macOS, delete the installation folder.

Install

Download and run Install_SPARTAN and follow the on-screen instructions. On Linux, run the installer in a terminal as root, or install into your home folder.

Run on Linux

After installation, run SPARTAN from the installation folder:

./run_Cornell_SPARTAN.sh /path/to/MATLAB/MATLAB_Runtime/v85

Replace the path with your installed MATLAB Runtime location.
